score_role: Nested forward development comparison on already-inspected history; no fresh holdout claim.
assumptions: All variants use identical dates and labels; adding a feature cannot remove a frozen validation date.
Parameters are selected once at each outer fold start using purged inner folds only.
The model is refitted periodically using labels known strictly before each prediction block.
Rolling windows are calendar years measured from the prediction block start.
Each refit uses the same fixed parameters until the next outer fold.
A drawdown feature measures current distance below the trailing peak.
No confidence threshold, new label definition, financial backtest, or ONNX deployment.

specification.role: Predeclared next study: dense conditional-return supervision for SAME three-class target; no fit yet
specification.motivation: Three-family categorical comparison shows weak outer generalization; hard class labels discard magnitude within each class. Test continuous future-return supervision without redefining evaluation labels.
specification.target: Evaluation remains VNINDEX T+20 return strictly below -5%, above +5%, else sideway, same1560 dates.
specification.features: Same original19 close/ETF/trend; no additional source or universe
regression_targets: future log return / (trailing20 daily log-return sample std * sqrt20)
specification.normalization_formula: Z=log(P[t+20]/P[t]) / (std(last20 completed daily log returns,ddof=1)*sqrt20); only past sigma enters normalizer.
specification.forecast_map: Fit one conditional quantile per level, sort predicted quantiles, convert normalized predictions back to log returns. Quadrature class mass = sum fixed atom weights with return < log(.95), > log(1.05), otherwise sideway. Threshold equality stays sideway.
decision_rules: argmax mass / mature-training class frequency; decision balancing only, not calibrated posterior
specification.timing: All training labels must mature strictly before global prediction/refit boundary. Raw-calendar labels and sigma before any feature filter.
specification.acceptance: Compare same dates/labels vs original trend and risk controls: +.02 mean fold F1, no worse worst F1, MCC gain, >=3 improved folds. No independent acceptance from repeatedly inspected history.
limitations: Quantile quadrature probabilities are approximate scores, not asserted calibrated event probabilities.
Previous quantile risk study used onlyq10 for binary risk; this study requires the full three-class distribution and fixed target.
No confidence subset, label policy change or automatic deployment.

configs: Expanding raw log-return quantiles + directional features
Expanding volatility-normalized log-return quantiles + directional features
supplementary_metrics: Raw quadrature mass log loss/Brier vs causal training-class frequency; descriptive only, not substituted for original macro-F1 acceptance.
label_rule: log(P[t+20]/P[t]) compared to +/- std(last20 daily log returns,ddof1)*sqrt20; equality sideway
primary: expanded_density_blend: classifier/old density/new density weights .5/.25/.25. Equal raw/normalized heads in each density.
parameters: Original fixed quantile specification unchanged, nine quantiles per model; only features change
acceptance: Mean macroF1 +.01, no loss in worst fold or mean bear/bull F1, higher MCC and >=3 fold wins vs incumbent. Both paired20/60 intervals >0 required for provisional robust evidence.
caveats: All dates are repeatedly inspected development. No threshold or weight tuning, calibrated probability, independent test or automatic deployment.
